offering_description.value: Operates online travel marketplaces and a B2B travel platform that let consumers and business partners book lodging, flights, car rentals, cruises and activities. It earns fees from travelers and from travel suppliers, and supplies booking technology and inventory to corporate, agency and affiliate partners.

primary_services.value: online lodging bookings; flight and car rental bookings; B2B travel booking platform and APIs; advertising on travel sites; vacation rental marketplace

customer_segment.value: B2C: leisure and business travelers booking trips directly on consumer sites and apps; B2B: travel suppliers such as hotels and airlines, corporate travel clients, travel agencies, affiliates and advertisers

end_markets.value: travel and tourism; hospitality and lodging; airlines; vacation rentals

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: merchant and agency commissions on lodging, air and other travel bookings; advertising: sponsored listings and media ads from hotels and travel brands; service fees: booking, B2B platform and partner fees, including traveler service fees
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; advertising; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: two-sided online marketplace connecting travel suppliers' inventory with consumers and B2B partners; financial intermediary: intermediates bookings between travelers and suppliers, collecting payment and earning commissions

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and Latin America, with sites in many countries

specialization.value: related lines: consumer brands, B2B travel platform and advertising, all online travel booking

distribution_channels.value: online: own websites and mobile apps for consumer brands; partners / resellers: B2B partners, travel agencies, corporate clients and affiliates reselling inventory via API; direct sales: sales teams signing hotels, airlines and B2B partners

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: consumer protection, data privacy rules such as GDPR, competition law, travel seller registration, lodging tax and short-term rental rules
